items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: Monk Montgomery used to play one... this was with Lionel Hampton’s band.

ctx.x: Yeah, sure. Especially when you start doing road work.

Well the rock & roll scene came along, but I also owned an electric bass. I had gained one of those back in the Air Force days in the early 50s because Monk Montgomery used to play one, and one of the guys in the barracks was talking about he heard the bass and didn’t see a bass anywhere. And it turned out to be — this was with Lionel Hampton’s band.
